registry: Mempool Surf Club Explore — Payments Research Registry

reference_schema.rule: Payments uses the approved Ordinals 24-field entity contract, lifecycle model, source-confidence model, provenance vocabulary, uncertainty handling, one-entity-one-profile discipline, and manifest + shards + human companion + validation pattern. Payments taxonomy is independently researched.

source_of_truth.rule: The manifest plus all listed record shards together are the canonical machine-readable research source. Markdown is the human companion. Nothing in this package publishes or changes the live Explore interface.

registry_wide_rules.one_entity_one_profile: One canonical payment entity/company/product family per PAYMENTS profile; child products/APIs/POS modes/protocol revisions consolidate or relate.
registry_wide_rules.status_rule: Lifecycle is separate from custody, jurisdiction, feature and source uncertainty. ACTIVE requires current verified operation; a reachable site/status page alone is insufficient.
registry_wide_rules.payments_boundary_rule: PAYMENTS covers commerce, merchant acceptance, settlement, remittance and payment connectivity. Wallets, Lightning implementations, exchanges and marketplaces stay canonical in their own categories.
registry_wide_rules.source_rule: Prefer official product/docs -> official GitHub/developer/support/legal/release material -> primary Bitcoin/BIP/BOLT/protocol evidence -> reputable independent corroboration -> directories/market data as support only.
registry_wide_rules.cross_category_rule: Canonical home is singular; use relationships instead of duplicates.
registry_wide_rules.source_confidence_rule: HIGH = strong first-party/primary support; MEDIUM = useful but important details incomplete/stale; LOW = core facts materially indirect. Confidence is separate from lifecycle.
registry_wide_rules.source_type_rule: Allowed source_type: official, official-github, primary, on-chain, independent, indexer, marketplace, market-data.
registry_wide_rules.uncertainty_rule: Unknown custody, jurisdiction, implementation support, fees or maturity stays explicit and does not automatically make lifecycle UNCERTAIN.
registry_wide_rules.custody_rule: State who can authorize spending/redeem value in the specific flow; do not conflate merchant-controlled software, hosted balances, processor custody, mint custody or direct BTC settlement.
registry_wide_rules.lightning_rule: Lightning is a Bitcoin-anchored payment-channel network, not a separate blockchain. Liquidity, routing, invoices/offers and custodial account layers must be distinguished.
registry_wide_rules.standards_rule: Specification status != deployment. LNURL is not a BOLT; Lightning Address is naming/discovery; BOLT12 support is not universal; BIP completion does not prove wallet support.
registry_wide_rules.commercial_data_rule: Fees, countries, limits, settlement currencies, counts, pricing and volumes are time-sensitive; date or omit them.

topic_architecture.purpose: Merchant-facing systems whose primary role is accepting, invoicing, processing or settling Bitcoin payments in commerce, including self-hosted software, hosted processors, point-of-sale products and contactless acceptance.

Infrastructure that exposes payment execution, Lightning operations, account layers, enterprise orchestration or cross-layer connectivity to applications rather than serving primarily as a consumer wallet or merchant checkout.
Bitcoin-native or Bitcoin-connected systems where the defining payment role is cross-border movement, regional settlement or access in constrained connectivity environments.
Durable commerce bridges whose core product makes Bitcoin spendable across merchants or services that do not necessarily accept Bitcoin natively.
Payment-specific interoperability, addressing, discovery and privacy standards that meaningfully shape how Bitcoin payment instructions are created, resolved or constructed.
Payment systems backed by bitcoin but using additional issuance or trust structures distinct from Bitcoin base-layer ownership and Lightning channel balances.

required_record_fields: Why it matters in the Bitcoin payments ecosystem

field_rules.Payments topic / subtopic: Must match one topic/subtopic pair in this registry taxonomy; one primary home per record.
field_rules.Status: Lifecycle only; separate from custody, feature uncertainty and source confidence.
field_rules.Source confidence: Evidence quality/completeness only; separate from lifecycle.
field_rules.Official website: Canonical first-party project/product site; null allowed where a historical protocol has no separate site.
field_rules.Official sources: First-party or primary sources with label, URL and controlled source_type.
field_rules.Corroborating sources: Independent/primary supporting sources, not substitutes for weak identity claims.
field_rules.Verification basis: Concise statement of evidence supporting identity, lifecycle and core payment architecture.
field_rules.Research notes / uncertainties: Explicit publication cautions including custody, settlement, jurisdiction, deployment and maturity limits.
